questions.stem: A 54-year-old male presents to the emergency department with sudden onset chest pain, palpitations, breathlessness, nausea and vomiting since the last 2 hours. There is no history of loss of consciousness. On examination, patient has BP = 100/40 mm Hg, PR = 56/min and RR = 21/min. Auscultation reveals 3/6 early systolic murmur in the mitral region and bibasilar crackles. Which additional finding do you expect to see on auscultation of this patient?
